updates.title: Taxi menu and NPC pickup recovery
changes: The Taxi tablet no longer crashes when daily reward settings arrive without a complete reward table. The overview uses configured values and safely handles partial menu data.
NPC pickup riders now retry after a failed spawn or if the ped disappears, instead of leaving the route waiting on a missing passenger.
Install gg_lib 1.0.11 first, then replace both included Taxi folders and restart gg_taxijob.

updates.title: Company capacity and RoadPhone Pro
changes: Company member limits now follow the configured upgrade tier for new and existing companies; the creation preview shows the configured starting capacity.
Company challenges now choose cabs the company owns and has unlocked, and rider classes at its level. If a target becomes unavailable, its progress resets and an attainable goal replaces it.
RoadPhone Pro support is included. Add the included AppStore entry and icons to RoadPhone once, then GG Lib detects the phone and delivers live Taxi updates. Install gg_lib 1.0.11 first.

updates.title: Vehicle image captures
changes: The Downtown Cab Co interior is bundled inside gg_taxijob_props again. Taxi requires only gg_taxijob and gg_taxijob_props; there is no separate MLO dependency.
Vehicle captures keep the confirmed FiveManage URL or local image path, and a local capture shows when gg_taxijob must be restarted to display the new photo.
Install the two Taxi folders together and update gg_lib first. Existing saved vehicle image paths continue to resolve.

updates.title: Vehicle image storage
changes: Taxi vehicle captures save the confirmed FiveManage URL or full local image path. Changing the local folder later does not redirect captured photos.
Bulk fleet photography saves each successful image to its matching rental entry; failed captures leave existing images in place.
Qbox vehicle keys are now granted from the server for GG Lib spawned depot vehicles, including pickup away from the car.
The Downtown Cab Co interior now ships in the included gg_cabco_mlo resource.

The Local Vehicle Image Folder setting shows the path under gg_taxijob/web/dist, accepts safe nested folders and controls new local captures and bare filenames. FiveManage URLs use their saved address.
After a local photo is captured, the vehicle editor shows a restart reminder beside the saved path. The Add Entry example Taxi remains available.
This package includes gg_taxijob, gg_taxijob_props and the new required gg_cabco_mlo. Install all three, start gg_cabco_mlo before gg_taxijob, and install gg_lib 1.0.10 first.
Choose Automatic, local or FiveManage storage in GG Settings > Generic Settings > Screenshots; the FiveManage key stays server-only.

updates.title: Company challenge menu fix
changes: Fixed the company management menu crashing after a company challenge pays a cash reward.
Challenge rewards now appear correctly in the treasury, with safe handling for unfamiliar transfer types.
Updated the new treasury labels in all nine languages. Continue using gg_lib 1.0.7; no new library update is required.

updates.title: Rental keys at custom depots
changes: Rental counter keys now use a standalone streamed prop so custom depots do not depend on the original depot interior being loaded.
Each depot keeps its own Key Desk position. Use Vehicles > Collect Keys From the Depot to enable or disable counter pickup.
Install gg_lib 1.0.7 for cd_garage rental-key removal. Replace both included Taxi resource folders and restart gg_lib before gg_taxijob.

updates.title: Rental menu closes immediately
changes: Taking out a rental now closes the Taxi menu immediately while the vehicle finishes preparing.
This prevents the menu from staying over gameplay after the rental appears.
Install gg_lib 1.0.6 with this update and replace both included Taxi resource folders.

updates.title: Saved settings, global job access and GKS Phone
changes: Renamed depots and edited lists now stay as saved instead of restoring default rows after reloads.
Added Global Job Requirement in General, OFF by default. Enable it to require one framework job everywhere; leave it off to use each depot's saved requirement.
Company creation now displays and uses your configured required level and deposit, including a zero deposit.
Preserved explicitly saved panel keybinds during startup instead of changing G back to the default.
Added automatic GKS Phone v2 Taxi app support with theme, open/close and keyboard-focus handling. Removed the misleading custom-app registration warning.
Updated the affected settings text across all nine languages. Install gg_lib 1.0.5 with this update and replace both included Taxi resource folders.

updates.title: More phone support, editable achievements and meter placement
changes: The Taxi app now supports sd-phone, yseries, yphone and yflip-phone alongside lb-phone. JPR Phone System is supported through the included !SETUP install kit.
Edit achievement tracking and reward tiers in game, including rides, distance, earnings, player fares, rider classes, pickup and drop-off areas, and vehicles. Existing progress carries over.
Fixed achievement payout accounts, enforced tier unlock levels and protected claims against duplicate payouts.
Set the company level cap and XP curve in GG Settings; open tablets refresh when it changes.
Zone fare multipliers now also apply to XP.
Player fares have stronger server checks and now contribute to achievements, company progress and statistics.
Driver and passenger share one meter position, placed using a live drag preview.
Improved NPC cab fuel initialization, driver spawning and cancellation recovery.
Updated achievement and settings translations across all nine languages.
Updated Taxi props to correct the depot fence collision geometry.

updates.title: Vehicle pictures, meter placement and Russian
changes: Every vehicle on the tablet showed the grey placeholder car instead of its photograph. The pictures were being asked for from the resource folder rather than the web folder they are written into, so none of them were ever found. Your captured images were never lost -- they were only being looked for in the wrong place
A picture that still cannot be found now falls back to the copy that shipped with the script, so a missing capture leaves one vehicle without a photo rather than an empty list

The meter can sit in a different place for the driver than it does for the passenger. Both are set once for the whole server, stay inside the screen wherever they are dragged, and go back to where they started from the same panel
A rental you delete stays deleted. Reloading the vehicle list no longer brings it back, and a vehicle you added by hand survives the same reload
Russian, throughout -- the job, its settings, the achievements and the meter
The rental outline follows its setting live. Turning it off, or changing its color, now reaches a cab that is already sitting on the forecourt instead of waiting for the next one to spawn
A rental can no longer be marked twice. Two markers on the same cab left a glow that nothing cleared when the driver got in

updates.title: The rebuild
changes: The whole job rebuilt on Script Studio -- every depot, vehicle, rider class, contract, reward, organization and phone setting is edited in game, by anyone you trust, with no file to open
Every setting applies live. Change a fare, a spawn, a blip or a zone and it is in effect before you have let go of the slider -- restart required is gone
The menu is new from nothing: search across every setting in every script, a rail that follows where you are, presets, per-setting help, undo, and a diff of what you changed before you save it
Gameplay rebuilt end to end -- pickups, the meter, fare steps, tips, ratings, the drop-off and the return to depot are all new code, not the old flow with settings bolted on
Job panel with a live meter, the current fare step and your rider, in place of the popups that used to cover half the screen
lb-phone taxi app: civilians hail a cab from their phone, on-duty drivers get the call, accept it and are routed there -- no third-party dispatch script needed
Vehicle editor: build every rental in game. Model, price, deposit, tier, livery, extras, colors and plate, previewed on the car in front of you
Ped and prop attacher, so a depot ped can be posed, dressed, given an animation or handed a prop or an animal without a single line of code
Twelve pickup zones across the city, each drawn in the world in debug mode, each moved by dragging it rather than by typing coordinates
Levels, achievements, daily challenges and a company board, all shared through gg_lib so every GG script counts the same day
Organizations: found a company, share vehicles and props with it, and work shared goals as a crew
Metric and imperial across the whole job, following the unit set in gg_lib
Bridges for fuel, keys, inventory, dispatch, targeting, banking and phone -- detected automatically, and overridable per server
Every entity the job spawns is now tracked and cleaned up on restart, so a stopped resource leaves no peds, cars or props behind

Customs bay on every rental: open the wrench beside a vehicle and it spawns in front of you with the whole tuner -- paint, wheels, brakes, livery, extras, neon, tint and plate -- and whatever it is wearing when you leave is what it spawns wearing
Roof kits fitted by eye: pick a kit and drag it into place on the car itself, with the paint you chose already on it, instead of typing offsets
Spawn any rental from its row to drive it, with the keys already handed to your framework, then delete it when you are done
Rebuild every vehicle image in one pass, with a live count of what is being photographed and a stop button, and the studio out of the way so you can watch it happen
Outline colour and how hard it reads are one setting now, picked from a colour wheel with an opacity slider under it
Rider classes are weighted rather than given a made-up percentage, and the odds each one actually works out to are shown as you change them
Prices are entered in your server's currency, formatted as you type; service times are entered in hours and minutes rather than raw seconds
Lists read as pictures and names -- a rider's face, a vehicle's photograph, an item's icon -- with the figures that matter labelled beside them instead of bare numbers
A setting that depends on another is greyed out and says which switch turns it on, rather than disappearing until you find it
